activity.notes: Shulgi was the second king of the Third Dynasty of Ur. Museum collections conventionally date his reign to approximately 2094–2047 BCE; because absolute third-millennium BCE chronology is reconstructed, ATLAS marks both boundaries approximate rather than presenting the conventional dates as modern-calendar precision.

sources.title: Tablet, ruler Shulgi — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Shulgi as ruler of the Third Dynasty of Ur and dates the object to his conventional reign, 2094–2047 BCE.

sources.title: Fragmentary statue of King Shulgi of Ur — Metropolitan Museum of Art
sources.citation_text: The Metropolitan Museum identifies Shulgi as king of Ur and dates his reign context to ca. 2094–2047 BCE.
